      GET INTO THE GROOVE

      Six tries.
      One mystery song.

      1. Play the clip. You start with just one second.
      2. Search for a song or artist, choose a result, and submit your guess.
      3. Wrong guesses and Hear more unlock 2, 4, 7, 11, then 16 seconds.

      Don’t know it? Use Skip song to reveal the answer immediately, then move on to the next track. Skipping the daily drop saves a loss for today; you can keep playing in Endless.

      The daily drop is the same song for everyone and resets at midnight UTC. Your progress stays on this browser.

      Endless rotation gives you fresh songs from your chosen genre and level. Easy draws from Deezer’s Top 100 chart (overall or your selected genre). Medium, Hard, Expert, and Impossible use progressively lower popularity scores, from familiar favourites to obscure tracks. Popularity is a guide to difficulty, not a guarantee you’ll recognise a song.

      Changing genre or level starts a new round. Every level keeps the same six guesses and clip lengths. Your level choice stays on this browser.

      Clips are excerpts, not necessarily song intros. Some songs contain explicit lyrics. Audio availability depends on Deezer and your region.
